issue.title: Use-after-free in `s_pack_internal` via re-entrant `__bool__`

labels.name: extension-modules
labels.description: C modules in the Modules dir

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

comments.body:
Possible fix in https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/143382, but I don't think we should go this way.

This is rather an artificial problem, not a real-world.  If we eventually move all initialization logic to the ``Struct.__new__()`` and make the Struct really immutable (see #78724) - this issue will be fixed too.  I don't think we need rather complicated temporary workaround.

I suggest closing this as a duplicate.
